methodology_other: Data were collected from the 2006 General Population Census of Libya, Demographic Indicators 2020 from the Bureau of Statistics and Census Libya, Results of the National Population Survey for 2012, Libya: Population Statistics, 2021, Consolidated Population Data from the United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs, and the Libya Displacement Baseline Assessment from the International Organization on Migration Displacement Tracking Matrix.
name: libya-subnational-boundaries-and-tabular-data
notes:
The geodatabase contains boundaries for the national and first-order administrative divisions aligned to the Large Scale International Boundaries dataset from the U.S. Department of State, as well as points for the second- and third-order administrative divisions. The feature classes are suitable for linking to the attribute data provided.

The tabular data contain total population for 2012 (estimates) and 2020 (estimates), as well as five-year age group and sex, and information relating to households, nationality, population displacement, household amenities, and internally displaced people and needs.
